use: unit 3 records: record cards and «find it» tasks
approvalRule: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {id, name, fact, caveat, disputed} (JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8). If any of these change, the approval no longer matches and the card must be re-approved before it is shown.

fact.en: Lake Baikal is the deepest and the oldest lake in the world: 1,642 m deep and about 25 million years old.
fact.ru: Байкал — самое глубокое и самое древнее озеро мира: глубина 1642 м, возраст около 25 миллионов лет.

fact.en: The Dead Sea is the lowest place on land: its shore lies about 430 m below the level of the ocean.
fact.ru: Мёртвое море — самое низкое место на суше: его берег лежит примерно на 430 м ниже уровня океана.

fact.en: The Caspian Sea is the largest lake in the world.
fact.ru: Каспийское море — самое большое озеро мира.
